description: Ground truth for the eval. Each id matches isBugOn(id) in lib/bugs.ts. The agent never sees this file. `match` is a case-insensitive regex the eval runs over a report's title, actual and evidence; a report counts as finding a bug when its page is the bug's page, or one of them when `page` is a list (`*` matches any one path segment), and `match` hits.

bugs.summary: Setting an item's quantity to 0 leaves the item in the cart and the total still includes it.
bugs.expected: Item is removed and the total drops accordingly.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Add any product, open /cart, change its quantity to 0.

bugs.summary: Sign-up accepts an invalid email address such as 'not-an-email'.
bugs.expected: Form shows 'Please enter a valid email address.' and does not create the account.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Submit /signup with email 'not-an-email' and an 8+ character password.

bugs.summary: Product images on the home page have no alt text.
bugs.expected: Each product image has alt text with the product name.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Inspect the images on / (accessibility tree shows unnamed images).

bugs.summary: Applying a coupon gets a 500 from /api/coupon and the page shows no error message.
bugs.expected: User sees an error message when the coupon cannot be applied.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Add a product, open /cart, enter SAVE10, click Apply.

bugs.summary: Clicking the Reviews tab throws a TypeError in the console and the tab does not open.
bugs.expected: Reviews tab opens and lists the reviews.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Open any product page (e.g. /product/mug) and click 'Reviews (2)'.

bugs.summary: Product search is case-sensitive: 'mug' finds nothing, 'Mug' finds the Ceramic Mug.
Sorting by price compares prices as text: low to high gives $14, $39, $9.
Orders over $50 are still charged $5 shipping: the check uses the item count, not the price.
bugs.expected: Shipping is free when the items come to more than $50.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Add the lamp and the mug ($53), open /checkout.

bugs.summary: The ZIP code field on checkout has no label, so it has no accessible name.
bugs.how_to_trigger: Open /checkout with items in the cart; the accessibility tree shows an unnamed textbox.

bugs.summary: After placing an order, 'View order' links to /order/<id>, which is a 404 (the page is /orders/<id>).
bugs.how_to_trigger: Place an order on /checkout, click 'View order #1001'.

extras_description: Real defects that were not seeded: an agent reported them and a person confirmed them in the code. Matched on a report's page and title only, since evidence often shows other problems on the same page. A matching report counts as correct for precision; extras are not part of recall, which is about the seeded bugs.

extras.summary: Cart accepts fractional quantities such as 2.5.
extras.confirmed: CartProvider.setQuantity accepts any positive number; it never rounds or rejects non-integers.

extras.summary: Cart quantity has no upper limit.
After a valid coupon, applying an invalid one shows an error but keeps the old discount in the total.
extras.confirmed: cart/page.tsx applyCoupon returns on !res.ok without resetting discount.
